Method of Attack: Authentication bypass using empty and invalid USERNAME and PASSWORD parameters
Impacted Systems: Apache OFBiz instances prior to version 18.12.11
Attack Vector: HTTP request with empty and invalid USERNAME and PASSWORD parameters
Parameter 'requirePasswordChange' set to 'Y' in the URL
Indicators of Compromise: Surge in exploitation attempts from 235 on December 27, 2023, to 26,928 on December 29, 2023, and 3,129 on January 1, 2024
